Trump Bans Foreign Energy Equipment, Declares National Emergency

U.S. President Donald Trump signed an executive order banning certain foreign energy equipment from the U.S. power grid, citing national security threats. He also declared a national emergency. The order specifically targets equipment that could be exploited by foreign adversaries. Separately, Trump announced the creation of a Space Force Academy and called into the International Space Station.
